summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Parched, a 2015 Indian drama film. It states who wrote, directed and produced the film, where it premiered, and when it was released in India.
one_line: Parched is a 2015 Indian drama film directed by Leena Yadav, premiered at TIFF 2015 and released in India in September 2016.
key_facts: Parched is a 2015 Indian drama film.
Parched was written and directed by Leena Yadav.
Parched was produced by Ajay Devgan under his banner Ajay Devgn FFilms.
Parched premiered at the Special Presentations section of the 2015 Toronto International Film Festival.
In India, Parched was released on 23 September 2016.
